title: Women In Distress and Detention Fund Amendment Ordinance 2009

sections.shortTitle: Women In Distress and Detention Fund Amendment Ordinance 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XII OF 2009
ORDINANCE XII OF 2009
WOMEN IN DISTRESS AND
DETENTION FUND
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2009
An Ordinance further to
amend the Women in Distress
and Detention Fund Act, 1996
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
4th July, 2009]
No.2(I)/2009-Pub.,
dated 4-7-2009.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is
hereby published for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further to amend
the Women in Distress and Detention Fund Act, 1996 (XV of 1996), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not
in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render
it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in
exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to
make and promulgate the following Ordinance.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Women in Distress and Detention Fund (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
